expected.reason: Request headers: Chrome sends its UA client hints (sec-ch-ua*, Chromium only) and its own user-agent; Crane's user-agent is Crane/0.1 (ruling 2026-11-21); the order of requestWillBeSent's headers is Blink's hash order. The response headers' order is a CDP finding (Chrome's Headers are a sorted dictionary) for Crane's Network domain.

visible: true asks whether the matched text is visible - a computed style and a non-empty bounding box (Puppeteer's checkVisibility) - and Crane has no layout (needs-renderer); Crane answers "visible is not supported by Crane's MCP server: Crane has no layout to tell whether text is visible."

The request headers differ as in "network: list, filter, details" call 5 (Chrome's UA client hints and user-agent; Blink's header order), and the response's date header is the second it was served. The bodies' sections and the saved files are compared: the files listing must be equal.

expected.case: history: back right after the first navigation
expected.reason: Chrome navigates its startup URL (Puppeteer starts it with about:blank: an auto_toplevel entry), so its first navigation pushes and back reaches about:blank; Firefox 159 and Safari 27.2 keep the first tab's initial about:blank, which the first navigation replaces (WebDriver probe, chat.local 2026-11-24, tmp/probes/mcp1-startup/run.sh: history.length stays 1, back() stays), as Crane and HTML do: the browser majority (main's ruling, 2026-11-24).
